t: You're outside the Forum in Kentish Town, now known as the O2 Forum Kentish Town. It is a concert venue owned by Live Nation Entertainment, and the building dates from 1934. Its architect was John Stanley Coombe Beard, known as J. Stanley Beard, who lived from 1890 to 1970. He was best known for designing cinemas in and around London, so this building comes from that part of his career. Today it hosts live music, but the shape of the building reflects its origins in the 1930s.
